# get_cd

```{r function-get_cd}
#' Download a browser WebDriver
#'
#' Resolves the WebDriver that matches the installed browser and stores it in
#' `dest_dir`. A cached driver for the same browser milestone is reused without
#' network access. Set `options(wdauto.mirror = "npmmirror")` (or the
#' `WDAUTO_MIRROR` environment variable) to try a mirror before the official
#' download servers. A named character vector of URL prefixes and their
#' replacements can be used for any other mirror.
#'
#' @param dest_dir Directory containing the WebDriver binaries.
#' @param browser Browser to manage, either `chrome` or `edge`.
#' @param zip Optional path to a driver archive that was downloaded manually,
#'   for computers without access to the download servers.
#' @return Invisibly, the path of the driver executable.
#' @export
get_cd <- function(dest_dir, browser = c("chrome", "edge"), zip = NULL) {
  browser <- match.arg(browser)
  require_windows()
  invisible(ensure_browser_driver(prepare_directory(dest_dir), browser, zip))
}

browser_installation <- function(browser) {
  edge <- browser == "edge"
  exe <- if (edge) "msedge.exe" else "chrome.exe"
  brand <- if (edge) "Microsoft Edge" else "Google Chrome"
  folders <- if (edge) c("Microsoft", "Edge") else c("Google", "Chrome")
  registry_path <- paste0("Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\App Paths\\", exe)
  app_paths <- unlist(lapply(c("HCU", "HLM"), function(hive) {
    unlist(lapply(c("default", "64-bit", "32-bit"), function(view) {
      tryCatch(suppressWarnings(unlist(utils::readRegistry(registry_path, hive, view = view))),
               error = function(error) NULL)
    }), use.names = FALSE)
  }), use.names = FALSE)
  roots <- Sys.getenv(c("LOCALAPPDATA", "ProgramW6432", "ProgramFiles", "ProgramFiles(x86)"))
  candidates <- c(app_paths, file.path(roots[nzchar(roots)], folders[1L], folders[2L], "Application", exe))
  candidates <- candidates[tolower(basename(candidates)) == exe & file.exists(candidates)]
  if (!length(candidates)) stop(brand, " was not found for this Windows account.", call. = FALSE)

  binary <- normalizePath(candidates[[1L]], winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  version <- run_tool("powershell.exe", c(
    "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-Command",
    "(Get-Item -LiteralPath $env:WDAUTO_BROWSER_EXE).VersionInfo.ProductVersion"
  ), env = c("current", WDAUTO_BROWSER_EXE = binary))
  version <- trimws(version)
  if (!is_chrome_version(version)) stop("Could not determine the installed ", brand, " version: ", binary, call. = FALSE)

  architecture <- Sys.getenv("PROCESSOR_ARCHITEW6432")
  if (!nzchar(architecture)) architecture <- Sys.getenv("PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE")
  platform <- switch(toupper(architecture), AMD64 = "win64", X86 = "win32",
                     ARM64 = if (edge) "arm64" else stop("ChromeDriver ARM64 is unsupported.", call. = FALSE),
                     stop("Unsupported Windows architecture for ChromeDriver: ", architecture, call. = FALSE))
  list(version = version, platform = platform)
}

is_chrome_version <- function(version) {
  length(version) == 1L && !is.na(version) && grepl("^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+){3}$", version)
}

chrome_build <- function(version) sub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", version)

chrome_milestone <- function(version) sub("\\..*$", "", version)

# Chrome and Edge drivers only reject browsers from a different milestone.
driver_compatible <- function(driver_version, browser_version) {
  is_chrome_version(driver_version) &&
    identical(chrome_milestone(driver_version), chrome_milestone(browser_version))
}

build_release <- function(version, platform, builds, milestones = function() list()) {
  build <- chrome_build(version)
  milestone <- chrome_milestone(version)
  release <- builds[[build]]
  if (is.null(release)) release <- milestones()[[milestone]]
  if (is.null(release) || !is_chrome_version(release$version) ||
      !startsWith(release$version, paste0(milestone, "."))) {
    stop("No matching ChromeDriver release for Chrome ", version, ".", call. = FALSE)
  }
  for (asset in release$downloads$chromedriver) {
    if (identical(asset$platform, platform)) return(list(version = release$version, url = asset$url))
  }
  stop("No ChromeDriver for ", platform, " in release ", release$version, ".", call. = FALSE)
}

npmmirror_rules <- c(
  "https://storage.googleapis.com/chrome-for-testing-public" = "https://cdn.npmmirror.com/binaries/chrome-for-testing",
  "https://chromedriver.storage.googleapis.com" = "https://registry.npmmirror.com/-/binary/chromedriver",
  "https://selenium-release.storage.googleapis.com" = "https://registry.npmmirror.com/-/binary/selenium"
)

mirror_rules <- function() {
  rules <- getOption("wdauto.mirror", Sys.getenv("WDAUTO_MIRROR"))
  if (is.null(rules) || identical(rules, "") || identical(rules, FALSE)) return(character())
  if (identical(rules, "npmmirror")) return(npmmirror_rules)
  if (!is.character(rules) || is.null(names(rules)) || anyNA(rules) || !all(nzchar(names(rules)))) {
    stop("wdauto.mirror must be \"npmmirror\" or a named character vector of URL prefixes.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  rules
}

# Mirror URLs are tried first; the official URL is always the last fallback.
candidate_urls <- function(url, rules = mirror_rules()) {
  hits <- rules[startsWith(url, names(rules))]
  if (!length(hits)) return(url)
  unique(c(paste0(sub("/+$", "", hits), substring(url, nchar(names(hits)) + 1L)), url))
}

fetch_url <- function(url, path = NULL, timeout = 120) {
  request <- httr2::request(url) |>
    httr2::req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
    httr2::req_options(connecttimeout = 15) |>
    httr2::req_timeout(timeout)
  if (is.null(path)) httr2::req_perform(request) else httr2::req_perform(request, path = path)
}

# Try every candidate URL in order and return the first successful response.
fetch_first <- function(url, path = NULL, timeout = 120) {
  failures <- character()
  for (candidate in candidate_urls(url)) {
    response <- tryCatch(fetch_url(candidate, path, timeout), error = function(error) {
      failures[[candidate]] <<- conditionMessage(error)
      NULL
    })
    if (!is.null(response)) return(response)
  }
  if (!is.null(path)) unlink(path)
  stop(errorCondition(paste0("Download failed:\n", paste0("  ", names(failures), ": ",
                                                          gsub("\\s+", " ", failures), collapse = "\n")),
                      class = "wdauto_download_error"))
}

response_json <- function(response) {
  jsonlite::fromJSON(httr2::resp_body_string(response), simplifyVector = FALSE)
}

response_text <- function(response) {
  bytes <- httr2::resp_body_raw(response)
  # Microsoft serves some release files as UTF-16LE with a BOM.
  text <- if (length(bytes) >= 2L && identical(as.integer(bytes[1:2]), c(255L, 254L))) {
    iconv(list(bytes[-(1:2)]), from = "UTF-16LE", to = "UTF-8")
  } else {
    rawToChar(bytes)
  }
  trimws(text)
}

cft_root <- "https://googlechromelabs.github.io/chrome-for-testing"

cft_download_url <- function(version, platform) {
  paste0("https://storage.googleapis.com/chrome-for-testing-public/", version, "/", platform,
         "/chromedriver-", platform, ".zip")
}

download_chromedriver <- function(chrome, archive) {
  if (as.integer(chrome_milestone(chrome$version)) <= 114L) {
    root <- "https://chromedriver.storage.googleapis.com"
    version <- response_text(fetch_first(paste0(root, "/LATEST_RELEASE_", chrome_build(chrome$version)), timeout = 60))
    if (!is_chrome_version(version) || chrome_build(version) != chrome_build(chrome$version)) {
      stop("The legacy server returned an incompatible ChromeDriver version.", call. = FALSE)
    }
    # The legacy Windows archive is named win32 and supports 64-bit Chrome.
    fetch_first(paste0(root, "/", version, "/chromedriver_win32.zip"), archive)
    return(invisible(version))
  }
  # Chrome for Testing publishes a ChromeDriver for every Chrome release since M115,
  # so the exact version is tried first without downloading the large metadata files.
  direct <- tryCatch({
    fetch_first(cft_download_url(chrome$version, chrome$platform), archive)
    TRUE
  }, wdauto_download_error = function(error) FALSE)
  if (direct) return(invisible(chrome$version))
  builds <- response_json(fetch_first(paste0(cft_root, "/latest-patch-versions-per-build-with-downloads.json"),
                                      timeout = 60))
  release <- build_release(chrome$version, chrome$platform, builds$builds, function() {
    response_json(fetch_first(paste0(cft_root, "/latest-versions-per-milestone-with-downloads.json"),
                              timeout = 60))$milestones
  })
  fetch_first(release$url, archive)
  invisible(release$version)
}

edgedriver_url <- function(version, platform) {
  paste0("https://msedgedriver.microsoft.com/", version, "/edgedriver_", platform, ".zip")
}

download_edgedriver <- function(edge, archive) {
  exact <- tryCatch({
    fetch_first(edgedriver_url(edge$version, edge$platform), archive)
    TRUE
  }, wdauto_download_error = function(error) FALSE)
  if (exact) return(invisible(edge$version))
  endpoint <- paste0("https://msedgedriver.microsoft.com/LATEST_RELEASE_", chrome_milestone(edge$version), "_WINDOWS")
  version <- response_text(fetch_first(endpoint, timeout = 60))
  if (!driver_compatible(version, edge$version)) {
    stop("Microsoft did not provide an EdgeDriver for Edge ", chrome_milestone(edge$version), ".", call. = FALSE)
  }
  fetch_first(edgedriver_url(version, edge$platform), archive)
  invisible(version)
}

installed_driver_version <- function(path) {
  output <- tryCatch(run_tool(path, "--version", combine_output = TRUE), error = function(error) "")
  found <- regmatches(output, regexpr("[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+){3}", output, perl = TRUE))
  if (is_chrome_version(found)) found else NA_character_
}

# Cached drivers live in <root>/<driver version>/<platform>/; older wdauto
# releases used <root>/<milestone>/. Only the chosen candidate is executed.
find_cached_driver <- function(root, chrome, executable = "chromedriver.exe") {
  if (!dir.exists(root)) return(NULL)
  files <- list.files(root, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  files <- files[tolower(basename(files)) == executable]
  parent <- basename(dirname(files))
  milestone <- chrome_milestone(chrome$version)
  modern <- parent == chrome$platform & vapply(basename(dirname(dirname(files))), is_chrome_version, logical(1))
  legacy <- parent == milestone
  versions <- ifelse(modern, basename(dirname(dirname(files))), NA_character_)
  versions[legacy] <- vapply(files[legacy], installed_driver_version, character(1))
  keep <- !is.na(versions) & chrome_milestone(versions) == milestone
  files <- files[keep]
  versions <- versions[keep]
  if (!length(files)) return(NULL)
  exact <- chrome_build(versions) == chrome_build(chrome$version)
  for (i in order(!exact, -xtfrm(numeric_version(versions)))) {
    if (identical(installed_driver_version(files[[i]]), unname(versions[[i]]))) return(files[[i]])
  }
  NULL
}

driver_executable <- function(browser) if (browser == "edge") "msedgedriver.exe" else "chromedriver.exe"

ensure_browser_driver <- function(dest_dir, browser, zip = NULL) {
  info <- browser_installation(browser)
  executable <- driver_executable(browser)
  root <- prepare_directory(file.path(dest_dir, sub("\\.exe$", "", executable)))
  if (is.null(zip)) {
    cached <- find_cached_driver(root, info, executable)
    if (!is.null(cached)) return(cached)
  } else if (!is.character(zip) || length(zip) != 1L || !file.exists(zip)) {
    stop("zip must be the path of an existing driver archive.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  lock <- directory_lock(file.path(root, ".download.lock"))
  on.exit(filelock::unlock(lock))
  if (is.null(zip)) {
    cached <- find_cached_driver(root, info, executable)
    if (!is.null(cached)) return(cached)
  }

  stage <- prepare_directory(tempfile(".driver-", tmpdir = root))
  on.exit(unlink(stage, recursive = TRUE), add = TRUE)
  archive <- file.path(stage, "driver.zip")
  if (!is.null(zip)) {
    if (!file.copy(zip, archive)) stop("Cannot read driver archive: ", zip, call. = FALSE)
  } else if (browser == "edge") {
    download_edgedriver(info, archive)
  } else {
    download_chromedriver(info, archive)
  }
  extracted <- extract_driver(archive, executable, stage)
  installed <- installed_driver_version(extracted)
  if (!driver_compatible(installed, info$version)) {
    stop(executable, " ", if (is.na(installed)) "with no version" else installed,
         " does not match the installed browser ", info$version, ".", call. = FALSE)
  }
  target <- file.path(prepare_directory(file.path(root, installed, info$platform)), executable)
  if (!identical(installed_driver_version(target), installed)) {
      if (!file.rename(extracted, target)) stop("Could not install WebDriver at ", target, ".", call. = FALSE)
  }
  prune_drivers(root, keep = installed)
  target
}

extract_driver <- function(archive, executable, exdir) {
  entries <- tryCatch(utils::unzip(archive, list = TRUE)$Name, error = function(error) character())
  entry <- entries[tolower(basename(entries)) == executable]
  if (length(entry) != 1L) stop("Driver archive does not contain exactly one ", executable, ".", call. = FALSE)
  extracted <- utils::unzip(archive, files = entry, exdir = exdir, junkpaths = TRUE)
  if (length(extracted) != 1L || !file.exists(extracted)) {
    stop("Could not extract ", executable, " from the driver archive.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  extracted
}

# Keep the newest driver versions; a driver that is still running cannot be
# removed on Windows and is left for a later run.
prune_drivers <- function(root, keep, versions_to_keep = 3L) {
  folders <- list.dirs(root, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
  folders <- folders[vapply(basename(folders), is_chrome_version, logical(1))]
  if (length(folders) <= versions_to_keep) return(invisible(NULL))
  ordered <- folders[order(numeric_version(basename(folders)), decreasing = TRUE)]
  stale <- setdiff(ordered[-seq_len(versions_to_keep)], file.path(root, keep))
  unlink(stale, recursive = TRUE)
  invisible(NULL)
}
```

# get_ss

```{r function-get_ss}
#' Download Selenium Server
#'
#' Only needed for the default `backend = "selenium"` of `auto_cs()` with
#' Chrome. The JAR is downloaded from the configured mirror (see `get_cd()`),
#' the Selenium release bucket, or GitHub Releases, in that order.
#'
#' @param dest_dir Directory containing the WebDriver binaries.
#' @param jar Optional path to a `selenium-server-standalone-3.141.59.jar` that
#'   was downloaded manually.
#' @return Invisibly, the path of the Selenium JAR.
#' @export
get_ss <- function(dest_dir, jar = NULL) {
  version <- "3.141.59"
  filename <- paste0("selenium-server-standalone-", version, ".jar")
  root <- file.path(prepare_directory(dest_dir), "selenium")
  legacy <- file.path(root, "3.141", filename)
  if (is.null(jar) && valid_selenium_jar(legacy)) return(invisible(legacy))
  directory <- prepare_directory(file.path(root, version))
  target <- file.path(directory, filename)
  lock <- directory_lock(file.path(directory, ".download.lock"))
  on.exit(filelock::unlock(lock))
  if (is.null(jar) && valid_selenium_jar(target)) return(invisible(target))

  stage <- tempfile(".selenium-", tmpdir = directory, fileext = ".jar")
  on.exit(unlink(stage), add = TRUE)
  if (!is.null(jar)) {
    if (!is.character(jar) || length(jar) != 1L || !file.copy(jar, stage)) {
      stop("jar must be the path of an existing Selenium JAR.", call. = FALSE)
    }
  } else {
    downloaded <- tryCatch({
      fetch_first(paste0("https://selenium-release.storage.googleapis.com/3.141/", filename), stage)
      TRUE
    }, wdauto_download_error = function(error) error)
    if (!isTRUE(downloaded)) {
      fetch_first(paste0("https://github.com/SeleniumHQ/selenium/releases/download/selenium-", version, "/", filename),
                  stage)
    }
  }
  if (!valid_selenium_jar(stage)) stop("The Selenium JAR is invalid.", call. = FALSE)
  if (!file.rename(stage, target)) stop("Cannot install the Selenium JAR: ", target, call. = FALSE)
  invisible(target)
}

valid_selenium_jar <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(FALSE)
  tryCatch({
    entries <- utils::unzip(path, list = TRUE)$Name
    "META-INF/MANIFEST.MF" %in% entries && any(grepl("GridLauncher(V3)?\\.class$", entries))
  }, warning = function(warning) FALSE, error = function(error) FALSE)
}
```

```{r example-get_ss, eval=FALSE}
get_ss(dest_dir = "C:/pptsdd-webdriver")
```

# auto_cs

```{r function-auto_cs}
#' Start a local WebDriver service
#'
#' Starts, or reuses, the managed WebDriver service for one browser. Chrome is
#' served at `127.0.0.1:4444/wd/hub` and Edge at `127.0.0.1:4445`.
#'
#' @param dest_dir Directory containing the WebDriver binaries.
#' @param autostart Whether to install or update the hidden Windows login
#'   startup entry. Use FALSE to start the service without writing it.
#' @param browser Browser to manage, either `chrome` or `edge`.
#' @param backend Chrome only. `"selenium"` runs Selenium Server 3.141.59 on
#'   Java, which also accepts the legacy JSON Wire protocol used by RSelenium.
#'   `"chromedriver"` runs ChromeDriver directly at the same address
#'   (W3C protocol only) and needs neither Java nor `get_ss()`.
#' @param restart What to do when the running service uses a different driver,
#'   for example after a browser update. `"if_idle"` restarts it when it has
#'   no open sessions; `"never"` raises an error instead.
#' @return Invisibly NULL once the service is ready.
#' @export
auto_cs <- function(dest_dir, autostart = TRUE, browser = c("chrome", "edge"),
                    backend = c("selenium", "chromedriver"), restart = c("if_idle", "never")) {
  browser <- match.arg(browser)
  backend <- if (browser == "edge") "edgedriver" else match.arg(backend)
  restart <- match.arg(restart)
  require_windows()
  stopifnot(is.logical(autostart), length(autostart) == 1L, !is.na(autostart))
  dest_dir <- prepare_directory(dest_dir)
  port <- webdriver_port(browser)
  state_dir <- service_directory(browser)
  lock <- directory_lock(file.path(state_dir, "service.lock"))
  on.exit(filelock::unlock(lock), add = TRUE)

  driver <- ensure_browser_driver(dest_dir, browser)
  jar <- if (backend == "selenium") installed_selenium_jar(dest_dir) else NULL
  state_file <- file.path(state_dir, "service.rds")
  state <- read_service_state(state_file)
  handle <- owned_process(state)
  if (!is.null(handle) && !same_service(state, backend, driver, jar)) {
    if (restart == "never" || !service_idle(backend, port)) {
      stop("WebDriver is still running with different binaries and has open sessions. ",
           "Finish active downloads, run reset_cs(), then start again.", call. = FALSE)
    }
    stop_service(handle)
    handle <- NULL
  }
  if (!is.null(handle)) {
    if (!with_wait(function() service_ready(state$pid, browser, backend))) {
      stop("Managed WebDriver is running but not ready. Logs: ", state$log_dir, call. = FALSE)
    }
  } else {
    if (length(listener_pids(port))) {
      stop("Port ", port, " is in use by a service not managed by this wdauto installation.", call. = FALSE)
    }
    launch_webdriver(browser, backend, jar, driver, state_dir, state_file)
  }
  if (autostart) configure_startup(state_dir, dest_dir, browser, backend)
  invisible(NULL)
}

require_windows <- function() {
  if (.Platform$OS.type != "windows") stop("wdauto WebDriver management requires Windows.", call. = FALSE)
}

prepare_directory <- function(path) {
  if (!is.character(path) || length(path) != 1L || is.na(path) || !nzchar(trimws(path))) {
    stop("Directory must be a non-empty path.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  path <- path.expand(path)
  if (!dir.exists(path)) dir.create(path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  if (!dir.exists(path)) stop("Cannot create directory: ", path, call. = FALSE)
  normalizePath(path, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
}

webdriver_port <- function(browser) if (browser == "edge") 4445L else 4444L

service_route <- function(backend) if (backend == "edgedriver") "" else "/wd/hub"

state_backend <- function(state) {
  if (!is.null(state$backend)) state$backend else if (identical(state$browser, "edge")) "edgedriver" else "selenium"
}

same_service <- function(state, backend, driver, jar) {
  identical(state_backend(state), backend) && identical(state$driver, driver) && identical(state$jar, jar)
}

service_directory <- function(browser = "chrome") {
  root <- Sys.getenv("LOCALAPPDATA")
  if (!nzchar(root)) stop("LOCALAPPDATA is not set for this Windows account.", call. = FALSE)
  path <- file.path(root, "wdauto")
  if (browser == "edge") path <- file.path(path, "edge")
  prepare_directory(path)
}

directory_lock <- function(path) {
  lock <- filelock::lock(path, timeout = 60000)
  if (is.null(lock)) stop("Timed out waiting for wdauto operation: ", path, call. = FALSE)
  lock
}

run_tool <- function(command, args, env = NULL, combine_output = FALSE) {
  result <- processx::run(command, args, env = env, timeout = 10000,
                          error_on_status = FALSE, windows_hide_window = TRUE,
                          stderr_to_stdout = combine_output)
  if (result$status != 0L || isTRUE(result$timeout)) {
    detail <- trimws(paste(result$stderr, result$stdout))
    if (isTRUE(result$timeout)) detail <- paste("timed out after 10 seconds.", detail)
    if (!nzchar(detail)) detail <- paste("exit status", result$status)
    stop(basename(command), " failed: ", detail, call. = FALSE)
  }
  result$stdout
}

installed_selenium_jar <- function(dest_dir) {
  prefix <- "^selenium-server-standalone-([23]\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+)\\.jar$"
  jars <- list.files(file.path(dest_dir, "selenium"), prefix, full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
  if (length(jars)) {
    versions <- numeric_version(sub(prefix, "\\1", basename(jars)))
    for (jar in jars[order(versions, decreasing = TRUE)]) {
      if (valid_selenium_jar(jar)) return(jar)
    }
  }
  stop("No valid standalone Selenium JAR found. Run get_ss(dest_dir), or use backend = \"chromedriver\".",
       call. = FALSE)
}

read_service_state <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  state <- tryCatch(readRDS(path), error = function(error) NULL)
  if (!is.list(state) || !all(c("pid", "time", "marker", "java", "driver", "jar", "log_dir") %in% names(state))) {
    stop("Invalid wdauto process record: ", path, call. = FALSE)
  }
  state
}

owned_process <- function(state) {
  if (is.null(state)) return(NULL)
  tryCatch({
    handle <- ps::ps_handle(state$pid, time = state$time)
    if (!ps::ps_is_running(handle)) return(NULL)
    args <- ps::ps_cmdline(handle)
    executable <- normalizePath(ps::ps_exe(handle), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
    expected <- if (is.null(state$jar)) state$marker else
      c(state$marker, state$jar, paste0("-Dwebdriver.chrome.driver=", state$driver))
    if (!identical(tolower(executable), tolower(state$java)) || !all(expected %in% args)) {
      stop("The process at the recorded PID could not be verified as owned by wdauto.", call. = FALSE)
    }
    handle
  }, no_such_process = function(error) NULL, zombie_process = function(error) NULL)
}

stop_service <- function(handle) {
  children <- tryCatch(ps::ps_children(handle, recursive = TRUE), error = function(error) list())
  tryCatch(ps::ps_kill(handle), no_such_process = function(error) NULL)
  for (child in children) {
    tryCatch(ps::ps_kill(child), error = function(error) NULL)
  }
  if (!with_wait(function() !ps::ps_is_running(handle))) {
    stop("Timed out waiting for managed WebDriver to stop.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}

listener_pids <- function(port = 4444L) {
  rows <- strsplit(trimws(run_tool("netstat.exe", "-ano")), "\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
  fields <- strsplit(trimws(rows), "[[:space:]]+")
  matching <- Filter(function(row) {
    length(row) == 5L && row[1L] == "TCP" && endsWith(row[2L], paste0(":", port)) &&
      row[3L] %in% c("0.0.0.0:0", "[::]:0")
  }, fields)
  unique(vapply(matching, function(row) as.integer(row[5L]), integer(1)))
}

local_request <- function(port, path) {
  httr2::request(paste0("http://127.0.0.1:", port, path)) |>
    httr2::req_options(noproxy = "127.0.0.1") |>
    httr2::req_timeout(2) |>
    httr2::req_perform() |>
    response_json()
}

service_ready <- function(pid, browser = "chrome", backend = "selenium") {
  port <- webdriver_port(browser)
  response <- tryCatch(local_request(port, paste0(service_route(backend), "/status")), error = function(error) NULL)
  if (!is.list(response)) return(FALSE)
  ready <- if (is.list(response$value)) response$value$ready else NULL
  if (is.null(ready)) ready <- identical(response$status, 0L) || identical(response$status, 0)
  isTRUE(ready) && pid %in% listener_pids(port)
}

# TRUE only when the service reports that no session is open.
service_idle <- function(backend, port) {
  response <- tryCatch(local_request(port, paste0(service_route(backend), "/sessions")), error = function(error) NULL)
  is.list(response) && is.list(response$value) && length(response$value) == 0L
}

with_wait <- function(ready, seconds = 30) {
  start <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
  repeat {
    if (ready()) return(TRUE)
    if (proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - start >= seconds) return(FALSE)
    Sys.sleep(0.25)
  }
}

prune_logs <- function(state_dir, keep = 5L) {
  logs <- list.files(state_dir, "^webdriver-", full.names = TRUE, include.dirs = TRUE)
  logs <- logs[dir.exists(logs)]
  if (length(logs) <= keep) return(invisible(NULL))
  unlink(logs[order(file.mtime(logs), decreasing = TRUE)][-seq_len(keep)], recursive = TRUE)
  invisible(NULL)
}

launch_webdriver <- function(browser, backend, jar, driver, state_dir, state_file) {
  port <- webdriver_port(browser)
  prune_logs(state_dir, keep = 4L)
  log_dir <- prepare_directory(tempfile("webdriver-", tmpdir = state_dir))
  if (backend == "selenium") {
    command <- unname(Sys.which("java"))
    if (!nzchar(command)) stop("Java was not found on PATH. Install Java or use backend = \"chromedriver\".", call. = FALSE)
    run_tool(command, "-version")
    marker <- paste0("-Dwdauto.instance=", basename(log_dir))
    args <- c(marker, paste0("-Dwebdriver.chrome.driver=", driver),
              "-jar", jar, "-host", "127.0.0.1", "-port", as.character(port))
  } else {
    # Without --allowed-ips the driver only listens on the loopback interface.
    command <- driver
    marker <- paste0("--log-path=", file.path(log_dir, "driver.log"))
    args <- c(marker, paste0("--port=", port))
    if (backend == "chromedriver") args <- c(args, "--url-base=/wd/hub")
  }
  command <- normalizePath(command, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  process <- processx::process$new(command, args,
    stdout = file.path(log_dir, "stdout.log"), stderr = file.path(log_dir, "stderr.log"),
    cleanup = FALSE, windows_hide_window = TRUE)
  started <- FALSE
  on.exit(if (!started) {
    try(process$kill(), silent = TRUE)
    unlink(state_file)
  }, add = TRUE)

  pid <- process$get_pid()
  time <- tryCatch(ps::ps_create_time(process$as_ps_handle()), error = function(error) {
    stop("WebDriver exited or could not be identified. Logs: ", log_dir, call. = FALSE)
  })
  state <- list(pid = pid, time = time, marker = marker, java = command, browser = browser,
                backend = backend, driver = driver, jar = jar, log_dir = log_dir)
  pending <- tempfile(".service-", tmpdir = state_dir)
  on.exit(unlink(pending), add = TRUE)
  saveRDS(state, pending)
  if (!file.rename(pending, state_file)) stop("Cannot save wdauto process state: ", state_file, call. = FALSE)
  ready <- with_wait(function() {
    if (!process$is_alive()) stop("WebDriver exited during startup. Logs: ", log_dir, call. = FALSE)
    service_ready(pid, browser, backend)
  })
  if (!ready) stop("Timed out waiting for WebDriver on port ", port, ". Logs: ", log_dir, call. = FALSE)
  started <- TRUE
}

startup_folder <- function() {
  appdata <- Sys.getenv("APPDATA")
  if (!nzchar(appdata)) stop("APPDATA is not set for this Windows account.", call. = FALSE)
  file.path(appdata, "Microsoft", "Windows", "Start Menu", "Programs", "Startup")
}

startup_file <- function(browser = "chrome") {
  file.path(startup_folder(), paste0("wdauto_", browser, ".vbs"))
}

# Batch launchers written by earlier wdauto releases.
legacy_startup_file <- function(browser = "chrome") {
  file.path(startup_folder(), if (browser == "edge") "wdauto_edge.bat" else "chrome_driver.bat")
}

startup_marker <- c("rem wdauto managed startup", "' wdauto managed startup")

read_text_lines <- function(file) {
  bytes <- readBin(file, "raw", file.size(file))
  text <- if (length(bytes) >= 2L && identical(as.integer(bytes[1:2]), c(255L, 254L))) {
    iconv(list(bytes[-(1:2)]), from = "UTF-16LE", to = "UTF-8")
  } else {
    rawToChar(bytes[bytes != as.raw(0L)])
  }
  if (is.na(text)) return(character())
  strsplit(text, "\r?\n")[[1L]]
}

owned_startup <- function(file) {
  if (!file.exists(file)) return(FALSE)
  lines <- tryCatch(read_text_lines(file), error = function(error) character())
  any(lines %in% startup_marker) ||
    (any(startsWith(lines, "mshta vbscript:createobject(")) &&
       any(startsWith(lines, "java -Dwebdriver.chrome.driver=") &
             grepl("selenium-server-standalone-", lines, fixed = TRUE)))
}

replace_file <- function(path, write) {
  temp <- tempfile(".wdauto-", tmpdir = dirname(path))
  on.exit(unlink(temp))
  write(temp)
  if (!file.rename(temp, path)) stop("Cannot update wdauto file: ", path, call. = FALSE)
}

replace_lines <- function(lines, path) replace_file(path, function(temp) writeLines(lines, temp))

# Windows Script Host reads UTF-16LE scripts with a BOM regardless of the code
# page, so paths with Chinese or other non-ASCII characters stay intact.
write_utf16_lines <- function(lines, path) {
  text <- paste0(paste(enc2utf8(lines), collapse = "\r\n"), "\r\n")
  bytes <- c(as.raw(c(0xFF, 0xFE)), iconv(text, from = "UTF-8", to = "UTF-16LE", toRaw = TRUE)[[1L]])
  replace_file(path, function(temp) writeBin(bytes, temp))
}

configure_startup <- function(state_dir, dest_dir, browser = "chrome", backend = "selenium") {
  entry <- startup_file(browser)
  if (file.exists(entry) && !owned_startup(entry)) {
    warning("Another startup entry already uses ", entry, ". It was preserved.", call. = FALSE)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  legacy <- legacy_startup_file(browser)
  if (owned_startup(legacy)) {
    unlink(legacy)
  } else if (file.exists(legacy)) {
    warning("A startup entry not managed by wdauto exists at ", legacy,
            ". It may start another WebDriver at login.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  script <- file.path(state_dir, "startup.R")
  lib <- dirname(getNamespaceInfo(asNamespace("wdauto"), "path"))
  mirror <- getOption("wdauto.mirror")
  replace_lines(c(
    paste0(".libPaths(c(", encodeString(lib, quote = '"'), ", .libPaths()))"),
    if (!is.null(mirror)) paste0("options(wdauto.mirror = ", deparse1(mirror), ")"),
    paste0("wdauto:::run_startup(", encodeString(dest_dir, quote = '"'),
           ", browser = ", encodeString(browser, quote = '"'),
           ", backend = ", encodeString(if (backend == "edgedriver") "selenium" else backend, quote = '"'),
           ", log = ", encodeString(file.path(state_dir, "startup.log"), quote = '"'), ")")
  ), script)
  windows_path <- function(path) gsub("/", "\\", path, fixed = TRUE)
  vbs_quote <- function(path) paste0('""', gsub('"', '""', windows_path(path), fixed = TRUE), '""')
  rscript <- file.path(R.home("bin"), "Rscript.exe")
  prepare_directory(dirname(entry))
  write_utf16_lines(c(
    startup_marker[[2L]],
    paste0('CreateObject("WScript.Shell").Run "', vbs_quote(rscript), " --no-save --no-restore ",
           vbs_quote(script), '", 0, False')
  ), entry)
  invisible(NULL)
}

# Runs at login. The network or the browser updater may not be ready yet, so
# the start is retried before giving up.
run_startup <- function(dest_dir, browser = "chrome", backend = "selenium", log,
                        attempts = 5L, wait = 30) {
  if (file.exists(log) && isTRUE(file.size(log) > 1e6)) file.rename(log, paste0(log, ".old"))
  con <- file(log, open = "a", encoding = "UTF-8")
  sink(con)
  sink(con, type = "message")
  on.exit({
    sink(type = "message")
    sink()
    close(con)
  })
  for (attempt in seq_len(attempts)) {
    message(format(Sys.time()), " starting ", browser, " WebDriver (attempt ", attempt, ")")
    started <- tryCatch({
      auto_cs(dest_dir, autostart = FALSE, browser = browser, backend = backend)
      TRUE
    }, error = function(error) {
      message("  ", conditionMessage(error))
      FALSE
    })
    if (started) {
      message("  ready")
      return(invisible(TRUE))
    }
    if (attempt < attempts) Sys.sleep(wait)
  }
  invisible(FALSE)
}
```

```{r example-auto_cs, eval=FALSE}
auto_cs(dest_dir = "C:/pptsdd-webdriver")
```



# reset_cs
    
```{r function-reset_cs}
#' Stop the managed browser driver and remove its login startup entry
#'
#' `reset_cs()` is the recovery tool: an unreadable process record or a
#' process that cannot be verified produces a warning, and the startup entry
#' is still removed.
#'
#' @param browser Browser to stop, either `chrome` or `edge`.
#'
#' @return Invisibly NULL.
#' @export
reset_cs <- function(browser = c("chrome", "edge")) {
  browser <- match.arg(browser)
  require_windows()
  state_dir <- service_directory(browser)
  lock <- directory_lock(file.path(state_dir, "service.lock"))
  on.exit(filelock::unlock(lock), add = TRUE)

  state_file <- file.path(state_dir, "service.rds")
  handle <- tryCatch(owned_process(read_service_state(state_file)), error = function(error) {
    warning(conditionMessage(error), " No process was stopped.", call. = FALSE)
    NULL
  })
  if (!is.null(handle)) stop_service(handle)
  if (unlink(state_file) != 0L) stop("Cannot remove wdauto process state: ", state_file, call. = FALSE)
  for (entry in c(startup_file(browser), legacy_startup_file(browser))) {
    if (owned_startup(entry) && unlink(entry) != 0L) {
      stop("Cannot remove the wdauto startup entry: ", entry, call. = FALSE)
    }
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}
```
  
```{r example-reset_cs, eval=FALSE}
auto_cs(dest_dir = "C:/pptsdd-webdriver")
reset_cs()
```
